registered_at: 2026-10-24, DRAFT before any script or outcome on the post-9/25 calls. NOT READY: needs the adversarial prereg review (max 2 rounds) before any build.
batch: standalone (operator 10/24: the callers pick names that move a lot; 'we want our exits to handle the losses')
study: Buy each actionable Discord LIVE callout (Bullish Bob / Trader Bro, ai_reports/bb_live.jsonl) and manage it with the desk's REAL exits (stop, ratchet, 15 s idle leash, time cap) instead of the fixed holds the 9/27 study used. Question: do the desk's exits turn the callouts' large two-way moves into a positive net mean?
prior: BB_LIVE_CALLOUTS_2026-09-27 (8/10-9/25, 1,730 calls): buy-at-call lost after cost at every fixed hold; 15-min gross ~flat; no better than a random later minute on the same name; 30-min MFE median ~+800 bp, MAE ~-850 bp. Desk exits on its own book: 42 exit shapes all ~0 gross (exits set the win rate, not the mean). Theory: with ~0 drift no stopping rule changes the gross mean; stop slippage on fast cheap names and wide spreads push net below zero. Expected result: FAIL.

data.calls: ai_reports/bb_live.jsonl on the mini: 52 sessions 2026-08-10 .. 2026-10-23 (18 sessions / 1,003 raw rows after 9/25; no rows 10/21-10/22). Session date from `unix` in ET. Dedup on (ticker, text, second) as the 9/27 study.
data.prices: Alpaca SIP 1-min bars and SIP trades (seconds) + SIP quotes from the data-only account (secrets_data.json); after hours only.
data.exits: The desk exit code as replayed in buystop_flow arm B (leash_replay / exit_capture path, ai_positions + bars + config imported from the repo), config pinned at sha 837dfd79268ebf16 (floor20-window-2) and the R used there; module shas recorded.

signal.population_primary: actionable calls (the 9/27 stance filter, same word lists, frozen in code before any outcome) between 09:31 and 15:30 ET; one open position per symbol (calls while a position is open are counted, not traded).
population_info: premarket calls 04:00-09:30 entered at 09:31 open (information only; premarket is IEX-blind live)
signal.filters: Common stock; entry price >= $1; quoted SIP spread at entry recorded, not filtered (the desk's spread gate result reported as information only).

trade.entry: Buy at the SIP ask at the first second >= call time + 5 s (operator reaction), else the next 1-min open + half the quoted spread. No look-ahead: the call timestamp is the archive's `unix`.
trade.exit: Desk exits on SIP seconds: fill the stop at the first trade at or below it (the trade price, so gap-throughs slip), sells at the bid; time cap as configured, hard exit 15:50.
trade.cost: Paid inside the fills (ask in, bid out) + 1 cent round trip when entry < $5.

control: Same name, same session, a seeded random second in (call + 2 min, call + 60 min] capped at 15:30, run through the identical entry and exits (the 9/27 baseline, now with desk exits). Second control: a seeded other callout name at the same second.
primary: Per-trade net return (bp) of the actionable population, day-clustered t; and the lift over the same-name control.
halves: A = 2026-08-10 .. 09-25 (already seen with fixed holds, never with desk exits); B = 2026-09-26 .. 10-23 (never analyzed). B is the decisive half.
pass: ALL of: (1) net mean >= +5 bp per trade in BOTH halves; (2) day-clustered t >= 2.0 pooled; (3) lift over the same-name control > 0 in both halves; (4) then forward on calls after 10/23 (>= 15 sessions) with net > 0. Anything else is FAIL or UNDERPOWERED.
count_step: Outcome-blind before scoring: trades per half (floor 250), sessions per half (floor 15), projected MDE from the control's dispersion (floor <= 25 bp; these names are wild). Below a floor = UNDERPOWERED, no outcome read.
canary: Plant +10 bp on all prices after entry; trades exiting on time in both runs must recover +10 bp (+/- 1).
information_only: exit-reason mix and average loss per reason
stop slippage (fill vs stop) in bp
the 9/27 fixed holds rerun on half B (does the old null still hold)
no_retuning: No change to the stance filter, entry delay, exit config, cost or pass bar after any outcome. Do not sweep exit knobs on this data; that is a separate prereg if ever.
common: Paper/research only; no config change. Desk config stays frozen for the floor20 window.
